description: The file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/InvisibilityCloak.csv' is already open in JASP. This dataset is from a real field experiment (Field, 2013) studying whether wearing an invisibility cloak increases mischievous behavior. The dataset has two columns: 'Cloak' (0 = no cloak, 1 = wearing cloak) and 'Mischief' (mischief score). Using JASP's T-Tests module, run an Independent Samples T-Test. Set 'Mischief' as the Dependent Variable and 'Cloak' as the Grouping Variable. Enable Student's t-test. Enable 'Descriptives' under Additional Statistics so the group means and standard deviations are reported. Leave all other settings at their defaults.
